test_cases.query: My Manulife "Critical Care Enhancer Rider (II)" covers "Heart Attack of Specified Severity". If I have this heart attack and am hospitalized in a Private Hospital, my bill is $80,000. If I have the "GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS" plan, how much do I need to pay out-of-pocket for this bill? (Assume I am under 80 and have not paid any deductible this year).
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: For a Private Hospital admission with the P PLUS plan (age under 80), you would pay a deductible of $3,500 plus 10% co-insurance on the remaining amount. Out-of-pocket = $3,500 + (0.10 x $76,500) = $3,500 + $7,650 = $11,150.
ground_truth_contexts: GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS: Private Hospital: Deductible (Under 80): $3,500
GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS: Private Hospital: Co-insurance: 10%

test_cases.query: I have the "GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS" plan with the "GREAT TotalCare P SIGNATURE" rider. I am admitted to a Private Hospital for surgery, and my total bill is $100,000. How much is my total out-of-pocket expense, considering the deductible, co-insurance, and the "Loss Limit" from the rider? (Assume I am under 80).
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: With the P PLUS plan, you pay a $3,500 deductible and 10% co-insurance on the remaining $96,500 = $9,650, totaling $13,150. The GREAT TotalCare P SIGNATURE rider reduces your out-of-pocket to the Loss Limit of $5,000.
ground_truth_contexts: GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS: Private Hospital: Deductible (Under 80): $3,500
GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS: Private Hospital: Co-insurance: 10%
GREAT TotalCare P SIGNATURE: Loss Limit: $5,000

test_cases.query: My Manulife plan provides a $1,000,000 benefit for "Total and Permanent Disability (TPD)". If I suffer an accident that results in TPD, does the "GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS" plan offer any additional lump sum payout, or does it only cover the related hospital and treatment bills?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS plan is a medical expense plan that only covers hospital and treatment bills. It does not provide any additional lump sum payout for Total and Permanent Disability.
ground_truth_contexts: GREAT SupremeHealth P PLUS: Coverage Type: Medical Expense Coverage (no lump sum for TPD)
